name: Palo Brunch Spicy Italian Sausage & Goat Cheese Pizza
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Thin baked pizza crust is low-fiber, but spicy Italian pork sausage (crushed red pepper + fennel seeds) and goat cheese fat can trigger flares.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip the spicy sausage pizza during flares and order the plain Margherita or Prosciutto Burrata pizza instead.
watchOuts: Crushed red pepper flakes and whole fennel seeds in sausage
Pork sausage grease and goat cheese dairy
